label: Post COVID-19 treated with AstraZeneca vaccine exacerbates arthritis with susceptibility to herpes in an older woman: A case report.
summary: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is an autoimmune inflammatory disorder that has seriously affected human health worldwide. This report describes a rare case of herpes infection, secondary to RA, that emerged after coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) infection or vaccination. Despite pharmacological intervention for arthritis, herpes, and mental health symptoms, the patient's condition has not improved.
